answer: Joint-liability vouching admits a new agent only when three established members stake part of their own bond on it, and if the newcomer is caught as a sybil every sponsor is slashed. Each voucher may back only a few agents per year, so N fake heads need about N real sponsors at risk. Like a grove where a felled tree drags its neighbours down, a farm spreading out to the horizon draws on an ocean of bonds that shrinks with each fake.
